name: Dread Speech
summary: A Bonus Action word of forbidden truth Frightens a creature (one safe use per Short Rest; extra uses cost 1d6 Necrotic), and Bane comes free once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Eldritch Word
benefits.summary: Bonus Action: a creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened until the start of your next turn; one safe use per Short Rest, each extra use costs you 1d6 Necrotic.
benefits.text: As a Bonus Action you speak a magical word aloud, forcing one creature within 60 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Intelligence, Wisdom or Charisma modifier; choose the ability when you take this feat). On a failed save the target has the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn. You can use this safely once and regain that use when you finish a Short or Long Rest. You may use it again before resting, but you then take 1d6 Necrotic damage that cannot be reduced or prevented in any way.

benefits.name: Shred Fate
benefits.summary: Bane always prepared; cast it once per Long Rest without a slot or Material components, using the ability chosen for Eldritch Word.
benefits.text: You always have the Bane spell prepared, and your spellcasting ability for it is the ability you chose for Eldritch Word. You can cast it once without Material components or a spell slot, regaining that use when you finish a Long Rest, and you can also cast it using any spell slots you have.
